movies.title: Whiplash
movies.synopsis: A driven jazz drummer confronts a demanding mentor at a prestigious conservatory, testing talent and nerve.
movies.recommendation_reason: An intense, claustrophobic study of ambition and mentorship in the music world, echoing Rock Star’s pressure-filled atmosphere.

movies.title: Almost Famous
movies.synopsis: A teenage journalist joins a rock band on tour in the 1970s, chasing fame, friendship, and the mystery of rock.
movies.recommendation_reason: A vivid, immersive look at rock touring life with coming-of-age nuance—perfect for fans of Rock Star’s industry-insider vibe.

movies.title: Sing Street
movies.synopsis: In 1980s Dublin, a boy forms a band to escape family troubles, turning personal growth into catchy, hopeful songs.
movies.recommendation_reason: Youthful, music-filled coming-of-age story with infectious tunes and a heartfelt look at making music under pressure.

movies.title: La La Land
movies.synopsis: Two aspiring artists chase love and stardom in modern Los Angeles, balancing ambition against the cost of fame.
movies.recommendation_reason: Stylish, music-driven cinema about pursuing dreams in a fame-obsessed world—an ideal match for Rock Star fans seeking emotional depth.

movies.title: School of Rock
movies.synopsis: A down-on-his-luck guitarist teaches a class of kids to form a rock band, discovering a new audience for musical rebellion.
movies.recommendation_reason: Playful, crowd-pleasing look at music education and performance with undeniable rock energy.

movies.title: This Is Spinal Tap
movies.synopsis: A spoof documentary follows a fictional heavy metal band on tour, satirizing rock culture with sharp wit.
movies.recommendation_reason: A clever, influential spoof that parodies rock mythos while delivering genuine music-world insight—great for Rock Star fans with a sense of humor.

movies.title: Begin Again
movies.synopsis: A chance encounter between a down-and-out producer and a gifted singer leads to an unlikely collaboration in New York's music scene.
movies.recommendation_reason: A grounded, hopeful look at collaboration and reinvention in the music industry, with intimate performances in a real-world setting.

movies.title: A Star Is Born
movies.synopsis: A seasoned musician mentors a rising singer, while fame and personal demons threaten their relationship.
movies.recommendation_reason: A modern, intense exploration of fame, artistry, and the costs of success in the music world.

movies.title: Inside Llewyn Davis
movies.synopsis: A talented but flawed folk musician navigates the 1960s New York scene, chasing opportunities while facing an uncertain future.
movies.recommendation_reason: Moody, character-driven look at the price of chasing a music career, with a sharp Coen brothers sensibility.

movies.title: Velvet Goldmine
movies.synopsis: A kaleidoscopic tale of a fictional glam rock icon and the era's myth-making around fame and identity.
movies.recommendation_reason: Stylish, provocative meditation on rock myth vs. reality, appealing to fans who crave era-defining music cinema.

movies.title: The Blues Brothers
movies.synopsis: Two blues-loving brothers embark on a mission to save their orphanage by reuniting their blues band and playing one last gig.
movies.recommendation_reason: High-energy musical comedy with iconic performances, ideal for fans of Rock Star's exuberant, soundtrack-driven moments.
